headline: Senior Backend Engineer | Payments infrastructure at scale | Python, Go, Kubernetes
about:
I build payment systems that stay up on the busiest day of the year. Last year I led the migration that cut our checkout error rate from 1.9% to 0.2% while traffic tripled.

I spend most of my time on the boring parts that decide whether a platform survives growth: idempotency, retries, reconciliation, and the observability that tells you which of the three failed.

Recent work:
- Rebuilt the settlement pipeline, reducing end-of-day reconciliation from 6 hours to 25 minutes.
- Grew a team of 3 engineers into 9 across two time zones.
- Cut infrastructure spend by 34% by moving stateless services to spot capacity.

I am always happy to compare notes on payments architecture. Email me at layla@example.com.

experiences.title: Senior Backend Engineer
experiences.description:

- Designed the caching layer that absorbed a 3x traffic increase with no added database capacity.
